But the fact that each component runs about four times slower under contention is the weakener, and it is stated as profiling evidence, so it is a new fact. On a strict reading, though, "each runs about four times slower" would put some components well past half a second only if they were near 0.125 s alone, which is not contradicted. The fact is therefore valid and consistent. Re-checking: it is a new, premise-consistent fact that gives real reason to doubt the screen finishes in time, so this criterion is met.

- Net: both criteria are met on a careful reading, which gives 2/2. Correcting the line above: Criterion 1 is met and Criterion 2 is met.

- Criterion 2 (says why the inference fails, with the direction right): Not met.
